{{Quote|The outlanders weren't hard to find, thanks to the frog man. You could tell he was a magnet for trouble. I found him on the market. He was lucky I did, because a Dug named Sebulba was about to squash him.|Anakin Skywalker|<ref name="Star Wars Episode I Journal: Anakin Skywalker">''[[Star Wars Journal: Anakin Skywalker]]''</ref>}}
The '''Mos Espa marketplace''' was a vast shopping area located in the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Mos Espa/Legends|Mos Espa]], a [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]] on the [[Star/Legends|sun]]-scorched [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]].<ref name="TPM">{{Film|I}}</ref> In the final decades of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], the marketplace was big and busy,<ref name="JJM">''[[Jar Jar's Mistake]]''</ref> with many shops and market stalls where various types of [[Fruit/Legends|fruits]], meat and beverages could be bought.<ref name="EIIG">''[[Star Wars: Episode I Insider's Guide]]''</ref>

The market was divided into several specialized quarters, some of which served the quotidian needs of the local inhabitants, while others housed engines [[Technician/Legends|mechanics]], [[Droid/Legends|droid]] repairers or even illegal weapons dealers. Many vendors of the Mos Espa market placed cooling units near their products as a way of drawing potential customers from the hot, suffocating steets.<ref name="TPMV">''[[Star Wars: Episode I: The Visual Dictionary]]''</ref> Among the food shops found on the marketplace were [[Gragra/Legends|Gragra's]] [[Gorgmonger/Legends|gorgmonger]] booth,<ref name="DBG">{{DB|character|gragra|Gragra}}</ref> [[Akim's Munch/Legends|Akim's Munch]] outdoor café<ref name="IWSWI">''[[Inside the Worlds of Star Wars: Episode I]]''</ref> and [[Jira/Legends|Jira's]] fruits stall.<ref name="DBJ">{{DB|character|jira|Jira}}</ref>

In the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]], the [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Qui-Gon Jinn/Legends|Qui-Gon Jinn]] walked across the Mos Espa market, along with the [[King/Legends|Queen]] [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]] (in disguise) and a [[Gungan/Legends|Gungan]] named [[Jar Jar Binks/Legends|Jar Jar Binks]].<ref name="TPM" /> Binks suddenly got hungry, and a market booth covered with [[Gorg/Legends|gorgs]] for sale caught his [[Eye/Legends|eye]]. [[Sebulba/Legends|Sebulba]], an angry [[Dug/Legends|Dug]] who was eating at a table nearby, started to bully the Gungan as revenge for the latter inadvertently ruining his [[Soup/Legends|soup]] by spitting the gorg out into the bowl.<ref name="JJM" /> Only the timely intervention of the [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] saved Binks from being severely beaten or even [[Death/Legends|killed]].<ref name="TPM" />
